responsibility: This header implements a small generic buffered lookahead queue used by the Rust frontend to wrap a token or item source that exposes `next()`. The `Rust::buffered_queue<T, Source>` template owns the underlying source, maintains a movable vector-backed window with `peek` and `skip` operations for arbitrary forward lookahead, and also provides limited front insertion and current-element replacement hooks used for parser or lexer recovery/manipulation. It therefore owns the reusable buffering mechanism that converts a one-item-at-a-time stream into a mutable queue suitable for frontend scanning and parsing logic.
